Reorder 80 / 100 * 25 equals 80 * 25 / 100 (both 20) and replaces the meaningless '£80 × 25 makes £2,000' with '£80 ÷ 100 makes £0.80', '£0.80 × 25 makes £20': a real 1% walk, £ on money only, 25 left as a count. The walk teaches a quarter (÷ 4); a different route to the same £20, not a contradiction.

'1 ÷ 2 makes 0.5' then '2 ÷ 0.5 makes 4': dividing by a decimal is not how the walk script teaches it ('Two halves make a litre, so 2 litres fill 4 glasses', i.e. 2 glasses per litre), and dividing by 0.5 is the very move the item's trap ('turn the half upside down') trips on. The 1 ÷ 2 line has no unit to tie it to the glass. Values correct; method contradicts the walk (criterion 4).
